verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own programmatic entry points: an API covering 100+ video, image, audio and LLM models, an MCP server that ChatGPT, Claude and other agents can connect to, and a machine-readable llms.txt that a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200. That plausibly lets an agent submit a generation prompt, but the evidence describes none of the rest of the loop. Missing for 10: documented job submission parameters, job-status polling or async job lifecycle, asset retrieval or download URLs, per-job cost or credit-usage reporting, API/MCP reference docs, and any hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the loop.
